question.text: Under the PMLA framework, who has the power to call for records from any reporting entity and additional information for the purposes of the Act?

answer.text: The Director (FIU-IND) as per Section 12A of PMLA

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 12A of PMLA empowers the Director to call for, from any reporting entity, records referred to in Section 12 and Section 12AA, as well as any additional information he considers necessary for the purposes of the Act. The Trap: The reporting entity is required to furnish the information sought by the Director within the time and manner specified, so this is not merely an advisory power. Note: Information called for by the Director under Section 12A must be kept confidential by the reporting entity.
